coderabbit.name: CodeRabbit Review
coderabbit.description: Runs the CodeRabbit command-line review over the feature's diff at the end of implement, and loops on the findings until the branch is clean. Catches on a local run what a pull-request review would cost a push and a review cycle.
coderabbit.author: BizStream

grill.name: Grilling
grill.description: Dependency-ordered interview rounds that close every open decision before work starts. Ships the protocol every question-asking command reads, plus a standalone command for a plan or a batch of specs.
grill.author: BizStream

qa.name: QA Walk
qa.description: Builds a QA wizard for a feature: one stage per acceptance scenario, each opening the page to check and recording pass or fail. For the manual pass a developer does before hand-off.
qa.author: BizStream

jira.name: Jira Cards
jira.description: Client-facing Jira cards, in either direction: written from a spec set as outcomes, or pulled from Jira so specs are written from them. One line in spec.md links a spec to its card. Verifies an implementation against the spec and any card criteria and posts the verdict on the card.
jira.author: BizStream

batch.name: Phase Batch
batch.description: Runs one Spec Kit phase across every ready target in parallel: specify, clarify, plan, tasks, or jira. Fans out subagents, reports one table per phase, gates jira on approval.
batch.author: BizStream

card.name: Implement Card
card.description: Takes one card from a written tasks.md to an open pull request: preflight against the constitution's gates, execute tasks.md, run every definition-of-done row, verify acceptance, loop a local review, then close out. Never merges.
card.author: BizStream

jev.name: Jev Decisions
jev.description: Typed decisions with Jev as a smart switch statement: regex floor cases in code, one Jev question for the residue, a declared fallback for every unsure answer. Ships the engine, the question bank and the calibration harness every other command calls.
jev.author: BizStream
